metadata.title: Aegis Sentinel Product System Assessment Results

results.title: Automated architecture assessment
results.description: Assessment results generated from verification evidence, authored risks, and compliance mappings.

control-selections.description: Controls reviewed through architecture-derived compliance mappings.

risks.title: False perimeter track
risks.description: Spoofed observations may cause an incorrect perimeter incident.
risks.statement: Multi-sensor correlation reduces but does not eliminate sophisticated spoofing.

risks.title: Former or transferred personnel retain access
risks.description: Delayed role-change or termination processing may leave inappropriate privileges active.
risks.statement: Manager and People Operations checkpoints govern access removal.

risks.title: Personnel miss security obligations
risks.description: Missing or overdue awareness education may increase human-centered security incidents.
risks.statement: Employee reporting is established but contractor completion is not yet integrated.

risks.title: Delayed privileged access review
risks.description: A delayed access review may leave obsolete privileges active.
risks.statement: Automated reminders exist but reviewer delegation remains incomplete.

risks.title: Credential replay risk
risks.description: Captured credentials may permit unauthorized product access.
risks.statement: Short credential lifetime and replay detection reduce exposure.
